transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I... well, things have been happening for months now. Just a pattern I've noticed. My sister’s appointments keep getting moved around, bills show up wrong, people conveniently forget to call me back... Everyone keeps saying it’s just mistakes. But... I know they’re keeping information from me. They're trying to push me out of decisions.
Have you ever heard or seen things that other people around you could not?
No... I haven't. I don't see things, if that's what you're asking.
Have you always tended to distrust other people, even before these recent problems?
No... not really. I've always been fine with people. I never had a reason to feel like this before.
Have you noticed any change in your motivation or interest in doing things lately?
Not really. I just... I still do what I need to do. I go to work, I handle my responsibilities. I haven't noticed any difference with that.
Do you think any outside force is controlling your thoughts or actions?
No. No, nothing like that. I'm... I'm in control of myself. It's just... other people that are the problem. But no, nobody is controlling my thoughts.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were not entirely your own?
No. I... I just said that. My thoughts are my own. Nobody is putting them there. I just know what I know.
Have you ever heard a voice that other people could not hear?
No. I don't... I don't hear voices. Just the regular sounds around me.
Have you had any head injury, stroke, seizure, or other brain illness before these beliefs started?
No. Nothing like that. I haven't had a stroke or... or a head injury. There is nothing wrong with my brain.
Do these suspicions make you distrust most people in general, or are they mainly about this specific situation?
It's... just this. I don't have a problem with people in general. Just... the things I've noticed with this one thing.
Have you started any new medications or used any recreational drugs or alcohol more heavily around the time these suspicions began?
No. I haven't... I don't use drugs. And there aren't any new medications. Just... no.
Do you believe these people are deliberately plotting against you?

I... yes. I mean, it's not a coincidence. For months now, I've seen the pattern. My sister's appointments keep getting moved around... bills show up with the wrong amounts... and people just happen to "forget" to call me back. Everyone keeps telling me it's just mistakes, administrative errors, but... I know they're keeping information from me. They're trying to push me out of the decisions about her care. It's deliberate.
How certain are you that this is really happening?

I'm... I'm certain. I mean, I've been seeing the same pattern for months. The appointments, the bills, the lack of communication... it's not just mistakes. I know they're keeping things from me. Trying to push me out. I just... I know it.
Before these recent problems, did you generally tend to think that other people had hidden motives or might take advantage of you?
No. I never... I didn't used to think like that. Just... recently. With her care. That's all.
Have you ever found any concrete proof that these people are deliberately doing this to you?
I... no. Not like a document or... anything like that. Just what I already told you. The things I see happening. That's all.
Before these recent problems, did you ever have similar suspicions or beliefs that other people were trying to deceive or harm you?
No. I... I already said no. It's just this. Just what's happening now.
If someone showed you clear proof that these delays and mistakes were accidental, would you be able to accept that?

I... I don't know how they could show me that. I've been seeing the same pattern for months now. Her appointments get moved around, the bills show up wrong, people just happen to forget to call me back. They all say it's just mistakes, but... I know they're keeping things from me. Trying to push me out of her care. So... no. I don't think I could just accept it's an accident.
Have you felt this level of distrust toward people in other parts of your life too, or only in this situation with your sister’s care?

No. It's... just this situation. With her care. 

Outside of trying to get straight answers from them... I still do my job. I pay my bills, keep my house in order. Everything else is fine. I know some people might think I'm too focused on this, but... I'm not falling apart. I'm not acting strangely in other parts of my life. It's just this.
Before these recent problems started, did you tend to prefer being alone and keep your distance from other people?
No. I... no. I supervise an office, so I'm around people all day. I don't keep my distance from anyone.
Have you ever believed that strangers, the media, or unrelated events were sending you special messages or clues meant specifically for you?
No. I don't... no. Nothing like that. I don't know why you would ask me that. I just watch the news normally. There aren't any... special messages.
Before these recent problems started, did you generally have a hard time trusting other people in close relationships?
No. I... no, I didn't. My relationships have always been fine. I trust the people I'm close to. I don't have a problem with that.
